info.title: OpenConnector Register
info.description: Integration platform register for the OpenConnector Nextcloud app. Manages Sources (outbound integrations), Endpoints (inbound API), Consumers (subscribers), Event/EventMessage/EventSubscription (event bus), Job/Mapping/Rule (workflow engine), Synchronization/SynchronizationContract (sync triad), and the four log schemas (CallLog, JobLog, SynchronizationLog, SynchronizationContractLog).

x-openregister.description: OpenConnector data model — thin client on OpenRegister; 15 schemas (11 mutable config + 4 append-only log). Replaces the 15 hand-rolled lib/Db/<Entity>Mapper.php classes shipped pre-chain-B.

openconnector.title: OpenConnector
openconnector.description: Integration platform register — Sources, Endpoints, Consumers, Events, Jobs, Mappings, Rules, Synchronizations + 4 log schemas.

source.title: Source
source.summary: An outbound integration target (HTTP API, database, or service)
source.description: A Source is the integration counterpart for inbound or outbound data exchange. It defines the connection (location, auth, headers) and operational state (rate limits, retention, last-call timestamps). One half of the Source/Synchronization/Contract triad — see local ADR-005.

type.description: Source kind dispatched at runtime by CallService. Recognised types: 'api' (default HTTP), 'database' (DB query), 'file' (filesystem), 'soap' (SOAPService dispatch), 'dso' (Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet via DSOAdapterService). Free-form to keep custom adapter types unblocked; CallService falls back to HTTP for unrecognised values.
type.title: Type

auth.description: Authentication strategy slug (apikey, basic, oauth, jwt, none)
auth.title: Authentication Strategy

authenticationConfig.description: Provider-specific auth configuration (object). Credential strings here are stored plaintext per local ADR-007 until EncryptionService ships (local ADR-016).
authenticationConfig.title: Authentication Configuration

authorizationPassthroughMethod.description: How auth flows to the upstream target
authorizationPassthroughMethod.title: Authorization Passthrough Method

accept.description: Default Accept header for outbound requests
accept.title: Accept Header

documentation.description: Public docs URL for the upstream API
documentation.title: Documentation URL

loggingConfig.description: Per-source override for CallLog retention windows
loggingConfig.title: Logging Configuration

oas.title: OpenAPI Spec

headers.title: Default Headers

translationConfig.description: Mapping/translation hooks applied to outbound payloads
translationConfig.title: Translation Configuration

configuration.description: Free-form structured config (provider-specific). `configuration.authentication` MAY carry a `credentialRef` object — `{"credentialId": "<uuid>"}` (primary) or `{"credentialName": "<name>"}` (convenience) — to dispatch this source's calls in-process through the OpenRegister credential broker instead of embedding secrets. When `credentialRef` is present: any sibling field under `authentication` is a hard 409 config error at call time (embedded secrets are FORBIDDEN, never merged); setting both `credentialId` and `credentialName`, or an empty value, is a 409; an ambiguous `credentialName` (0 or >1 owned matches) is a 409; SOAP sources, asynchronous dispatch, and `cert`/`ssl_key` config are rejected in v1. The provider catalogue's host-lock is the sole authority for the target host — `location` remains configuration documentation. See http-call-engine spec REQ-SBC-001/002 (change source-broker-credentials). `configuration.decompress: "gzip"` (oc#97) hints that the fetched body is a gzip-compressed file (also auto-detected from a `.gz`-suffixed endpoint or an `application/gzip` response Content-Type) — gunzipped before the existing JSON/XML/JSONL parse attempts; `.tar.gz`/`.tar` archives are detected but NOT supported (logged + skipped, see synchronization-engine spec REQ-006, change bulk-gzip-jsonl-ingestion). `configuration.listMethod`/`configuration.body` (pre-existing, see decideMethod/mergeSourceConfiguration) let a source declare a static POST body template — see `sourceConfig.paginationIn` below for advancing it across pages (change post-body-pagination).
configuration.title: Configuration

errorRetention.description: Per-source override for error log retention. Stored in seconds; JobService DEFAULT_ERROR_LOG_RETENTION is 2592000000 ms = 2592000 s = P30D.
errorRetention.title: Error Retention

status.description: Delivery state. Enforced lifecycle: pending → delivered (terminal, 2xx) | failed (non-2xx/exception, retryCount < maxRetries) → abandoned (terminal, retryCount >= maxRetries). An operator may replay a failed/abandoned message (→ pending) or discard it (→ discarded, terminal); discarded is never swept and never hard-deleted.

synchronization.title: Synchronization
synchronization.summary: A bidirectional or unidirectional sync between two systems
synchronization.description: A Synchronization is one half of the Source/Sync/Contract triad (see local ADR-005). It defines what to sync (sourceId/targetId), how to compare (sourceHashMapping), and per-pass state (currentPage, last-checked timestamps). The `sourceId`/`targetId` fields have an overloaded format documented inline.

sourceId.description: Polymorphic source identifier. Overloaded format: (1) numeric string `'42'` = legacy integer Source PK; (2) `register/schema` slug pair = OR-internal source; (3) UUID string = post-chain-B canonical OR identifier. Chain B's migrator branches on the format to translate (1) to (3). Cross-ref: chain-B REQ on sourceId 3-format branching.
sourceId.title: Source ID

sourceHash.description: Hash of last-known source state (for change detection)
sourceHash.title: Source Hash

sourceHashMapping.description: Mapping slug used to compute the source hash
sourceHashMapping.title: Source Hash Mapping

sourceTargetMapping.description: Mapping slug for source-to-target field transformation
sourceTargetMapping.title: Source Target Mapping

sourceConfig.description: Source-specific configuration overrides. Notable recognised keys: `resultsPosition` (dot-path to the objects array in the response, or `_root`/`_object`); `format: "jsonl"` (oc#97) — the fetched (and, if gzip, decompressed) body is parsed as line-delimited JSON, one record per line, instead of whole-document JSON/XML — pair with `resultsPosition: "_root"` since the parsed line array IS the records list; `paginationQuery` (field name/dot-path to bump per page, default `page`); `paginationIn: "body"` (oc#94, default `"query"`) — substitutes the next page value into the source's static `configuration.body` JSON template at the `paginationQuery` dot-path instead of the query string, for POST-body sources (e.g. TED's v3 search) whose pagination cursor lives in the request body. See synchronization-engine spec REQ-006 (change bulk-gzip-jsonl-ingestion) and http-call-engine spec REQ-006 (change post-body-pagination).
sourceConfig.title: Source Configuration
